issues.detail: The Hebrew 'רוּחוֹת' (ruḥot) here means 'directions/winds' (i.e., the four directions), not '靈' (spirits). The Chinese '四方的靈' (spirits of the four directions) misrepresents the meaning; it should be '四方的方向' or '四方' (four directions). This changes the factual claim from directions to spiritual beings.
